description: A standardized CLI wrapper for RDKit molecular featurization workflows that handles physicochemical descriptor computation (outputs .csv) and molecular fingerprint extraction (outputs .npy or .csv), with built-in SMILES validation. USE WHEN you need to compute RDKit molecular descriptors or fingerprints from SMILES datasets (.csv/.smi), or when you want to list all available descriptor names and presets.
